title: StrikeCandidate
description: A possible strike produced by geometry from an observed (REACTIVE) or predicted (RULE/MODEL) trajectory (Phase 01 contract; produced by geometry, Phase 04; consumed by commit, Phase 05), or - diagnostic harness modes only - by the direct-head adapter (derivation DIRECT_HEAD). docs/architecture/contracts.md section 3.7. ADR-0007, ADR-0008.

frame_id.description: Frame whose trajectory (observed or predicted) produced the candidate.

derivation.description: GEOMETRY: produced by geometry.intersect from a trajectory (the trajectory-first path; the only derivation allowed in the live application). DIRECT_HEAD: produced from a DirectPrediction's heads without geometry - permitted only for source MODEL in the diagnostic harness modes of Phase 09 (C-GBDT direct mode) and Phase 19 (AB-NOTRAJ); every result derived from it is labelled 'direct / no-trajectory (diagnostic)'.

anticipator_id.description: Anticipator that produced the predicted trajectory (RULE/MODEL); null for REACTIVE.

t_impact_pred.description: Predicted impact time (README section 5.2). Null for REACTIVE.

t_impact_est.description: Sub-frame interpolated crossing time of the OBSERVED tip (README section 5.2). Set for REACTIVE; null for RULE/MODEL.

tti.description: Time-to-Impact = t_impact_pred - t_capture (README section 6). Null for REACTIVE.

impact_position.description: Crossing point on the impact surface, ROI-normalized.

strike_probability.description: Source-agnostic confidence used by the commit policy; null when the source provides none (REACTIVE may use 1.0 or null).

intensity_proxy.description: Kinematic intensity proxy at the crossing (README section 6). Not force.

t_candidate.description: Instant the candidate was emitted (README section 5.2).
